name: Botono
description: The helmsman injured by the dragon and later appears as a Phyrexian tentacle head in a nightmarish engine room.

timeline.summary: A skeletal dragon attacks the Weatherlight, injuring Botono, and a lance tears a hole in the starboard wing.
timeline.quote: one of the lances from tearing a hole in the starboard wing

timeline.summary: Inside, Shanna destroys tentacles wearing the heads of Botono, Ulaten and Anyxni and frees Slimefoot and the powerstone.
timeline.quote: One thrust, and Botono's death was final

pages_say.description: The helmsman injured by the dragon and later appears as a Phyrexian tentacle head in a nightmarish engine room.
